title: fix(sdk): return model arrays and reject failed images
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Points `Pollinations.models()` at `/models`, matching its documented array return type.
- Rejects non-2xx generated-image URL downloads through the existing SDK error parser.
- Adds focused regression coverage for both paths.

Checks: SDK tests (37), typecheck, build, Biome.

gist.headline: Models, now in a proper row
gist.blurb: The SDK has stopped handing you a mystery-shaped model response. `Pollinations.models()` now returns the array it promised, and failed image downloads raise a useful error instead of quietly pretending to be pixels.
gist.summary: Fixed the SDK so `Pollinations.models()` calls `/models` and returns its documented model array, while generated-image URL downloads now reject non-2xx responses through the existing SDK error parser.
gist.impact: SDK users can reliably iterate over available models and receive actionable errors when an image-generation download fails instead of treating an error response as an image.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is organizing a neat row of model cards from a retro terminal's `/models` output, while a friendly CRT monitor robot spots a failed image download and routes it into a clearly labeled error jar rather than the pixel gallery. Code-plants and small flowers make the SDK repair feel like careful garden maintenance.

Lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently among warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach code-plants and flowers; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle pixel-font text: 'ARRAY OK'.
